content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations.
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a rear case support assembly with two mounting configurations: one on the left using machine screws and self-locking nuts, and one on the right using rivets or machine screws and self-locking nuts.

Labels and text printed in the figure:
- Machine screws and self-locking nuts
- Rear case support
- Rivets or Machine screws and self-locking nuts

No part numbers, values, units, or notes are printed in the figure.
